game_concept: A strategy race set in Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood, the glowing ancient tree: the forest ranger must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood: the glowing ancient tree
core_gameplay_loop: In Glowing Heartwood, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the forest ranger ahead. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the spirit shrine by solving code steps involving picks_right that move the forest ranger forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the spirit shrine first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Loop Picker
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
